articles.title: Long-running women's health studies reveal lasting lessons for disease prevention and healthy aging
articles.excerpt: Andrea Romanos-Nanclares, Ph.D., of the Channing Division of Network Medicine within the Department of Medicine at Mass General Brigham, is the lead author of a paper published in The Lancet Obstetrics, Gynaecology, & Women's Health titled "The Nurses' Health Studies: a half-century of discovery in
articles.summary: 该报道介绍发表于《The Lancet Obstetrics, Gynaecology, & Women's Health》的论文《The Nurses' Health Studies: a half-century of discovery in...》，由Mass General Brigham的Andrea Romanos-Nanclares等撰写，总结长期女性健康研究对疾病预防和健康老龄化的启示。
